emotional_tone: Clean, calm, professional, trustworthy, precise, low-cognitive-load

theme_strategy.rationale: Medical and clinical staff require high legibility during long shifts. Light mode provides high-contrast daylight visibility, while night-shift nurses can switch to dark mode. Surfaces are flat solid to avoid refraction of critical health parameters.

body.font_family: IBM Plex Sans, DM Sans, sans-serif

labels_and_overlines.style: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

mono_data.font_family: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace
mono_data.style: text-xs font-mono font-medium tracking-normal text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200

colors.contrast_rules: Maintain minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio across all text elements. Clinical data badges must use high-contrast text color explicitly paired with light background pills.

surface_and_layout_strategy.card_style: Solid background with delicate 1px border. Never use translucent glassmorphism for medical data tables or patient vitals to avoid refraction and data misreading.
surface_and_layout_strategy.bento_density_mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (Dashboards/Analytics/Clinical Timeline). Base grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Spacing: gap-4 or gap-6.
surface_and_layout_strategy.patient_360_layout: Header banner with core patient demographics + Suicidality/Risk Indicator -> Left column 4-col span (Vitals, Active Medications, MSE Radar) -> Right column 8-col span (Timeline, DSM-5 Diagnosis, Clinical Notes, Treatment Plan).
surface_and_layout_strategy.opd_ipd_consoles: Cardless dense matrix layout for beds & appointment tokens with quick filter tabs and status chips.

motion_and_microinteractions.philosophy: Calm, functional, instant feedback. Avoid ornamental floating shapes or distracting bouncy physics.
motion_and_microinteractions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. Disable tab animations when reduced motion is preferred.

navigation.type: Responsive Sidebar + Top Clinical Context Bar
navigation.mobile: Sheet slide-over navigation with sticky touch target items
navigation.role_switcher: Dropdown at top sidebar to toggle roles: Admin, Psychiatrist, Psychologist, Nurse, Receptionist, Pharmacist, Billing Officer

printable_documents: Prescription Document (A4 format with header, Rx table, warning signatures)
Discharge Summary (Psychiatric progress notes, follow-up date, emergency contact)
Tax Billing Invoice (Itemized breakdown, tax details, patient copy)

testing_and_automation.mandatory_data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, search inputs, tab switches, dropdown items, role switchers, table rows, bed allocation cards, print triggers, modal actions) MUST feature explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure SvaTWA feels like a genuine, high-precision psychiatric hospital ERP with rich mock clinical data (ICD-11 codes, DSM-5 criteria, Hamilton Depression Rating Scale, MSE categories, psychotropic medication schedules).
Never produce empty or plain states without functional tools; populate mock patient records with realistic psychiatric histories.
Provide clear role switching mechanism at top so users can test as Psychiatrist, Psychologist, Nurse, Pharmacist, Billing Officer, Receptionist, or Admin.
Include printable views formatted cleanly with window.print() CSS media queries for Prescriptions, Discharge Summaries, and Invoices.
Strictly follow data-testid conventions for all actions and elements.
